text: {"lessons":["Selling winning positions felt satisfying, but I should weigh each trade against my overall plan rather than treating every stock as a separate account.","A gain since my purchase price does not mean a stock will fall, and a loss would not by itself mean it will recover; past price moves do not predict future ones.","I should avoid trading just because I check my account frequently, and keep enough cash and diversification for my longer-term needs."]}
